 Updated: 10:41 PM EST Nov 5, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Andrew Stockey Anchor & Sports Director PITTSBURGH — It's time for the high school football playoffs in Western Pennsylvania.
 Operation Football is covering seven WPIAL playoff games on Friday night.
 Advertisement 
 Game of the Week: Blackhawk at McKeesport
 Moon at Thomas Jefferson
 Armstrong at Woodland Hills
 West Mifflin at Freeport
 Monessen at Jeannette
 Waynesburg Central at Aliquippa
 Beaver Falls at McGuffey 
 NOTE : This list is subject to change. Click here for a full schedule of Friday night's WPIAL playoff games.
 Download the WTAE app to receive a mobile alert with final scores on Friday night.
